extraction.name: EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification
extraction.description: A novel dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images covering 13 spectral bands and consisting of 10 classes with in total 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images for land use and land cover classification.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
extraction.citeAs: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth. EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification. arXiv:1709.00029v2 [cs.CV] 1 Feb 2019.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: We gathered satellite images of European cities distributed in over 34 countries. Based on the obtained satellite images, we created a dataset of 27,000 georeferenced and labeled image patches. The image patches measure 64x64 pixels and have been manually checked.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Sentinel-2 satellite images provided by the Sentinel-2A satellite via Amazon S3, covering European cities from the European Urban Atlas.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Satellite images were acquired from Sentinel-2A (launched June 2015) and Sentinel-2B (launched March 2017), with data collection timeframe not explicitly specified beyond satellite launch dates.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: We manually checked all 27,000 images multiple times and corrected the ground truth by sorting out mislabeled images as well as images full of snow or ice. The proposed dataset has not received atmospheric correction.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: We selected satellite images with a low cloud level. Bands with a lower spatial resolution have been upsampled to 10 meters per pixel using cubic-spline interpolation. Image patches measure 64x64 pixels.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset consists of 10 different land use and land cover classes based on the European Urban Atlas mapping guide. Images were manually checked and labeled.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset enables applications in agriculture, disaster recovery, climate change, urban development, or environmental monitoring. It can be used for land use and land cover change detection and improving geographical maps.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset covers European cities distributed over 34 countries, aiming to cover high intra-class variance. Images were recorded all over the year to get variance in land use and land cover classes.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset uses a 10 meters per pixel spatial resolution, which is lower than some benchmark datasets. It has not received atmospheric correction, which can result in images with a color cast.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation for land use and land cover classification using deep learning models such as CNNs. Can be used for change detection and mapping assistance.
